# Combined Quarterly Report: Revenue & Unit Sales by Region

## Section 1: Quarterly Unit Sales by Region
*Source: Agent 3 local data — `/data/units.csv`*

| Quarter | Region | Units Sold |
|---------|--------|------------|
| Q1      | North  | 340        |
| Q1      | South  | 280        |
| Q2      | North  | 390        |
| Q2      | South  | 310        |

### Unit Sales Summary

| Region | Q1 Units | Q2 Units | Total Units | QoQ Change |
|--------|----------|----------|-------------|------------|
| North  | 340      | 390      | 730         | +14.7%     |
| South  | 280      | 310      | 590         | +10.7%     |
| **Total** | **620** | **700** | **1,320**  | **+12.9%** |

**Key Observations — Units:**
- Overall unit volume grew **12.9% quarter-over-quarter** (Q1→Q2).
- The **North region** leads in absolute units both quarters (340 → 390).
- The **South region** also showed healthy growth (280 → 310), though it trails North by ~25 units in Q2.
- Combined Q1 total: **620 units**; Combined Q2 total: **700 units**.
